_how_to_edit: To publish a post: add posts/<slug>.md (plain markdown) and add an entry to "posts" below. slug = lowercase letters, numbers and dashes, matching the file name. date = YYYY-MM-DD; a future date stays hidden until that day. "draft": true keeps it hidden. Optional: dek (one-line teaser), category (e.g. Dating, Ranked, Advice), author, image (e.g. /assets/blog/<file>.jpg). While this list has no live posts, the Blog link and /blog/ stay hidden.
